props.title: Byala, Black Sea
props.caption: Sea and aerial drones hit two merchant ships about 70 nautical miles east of Byala. Alfa Watan sank and Able burned; a Bulgarian ferry evacuated 18 crew.

props.title: Sparrows Point, Maryland
props.caption: Maryland and Baltimore County announced Anduril's $3.7 billion Arsenal-2 shipyard in Baltimore County, a two-million-square-foot software-defined yard.
Saxony-Anhalt's Landtag elected AfD's Tobias Rausch president on 48 yes votes of 82 valid. He is the first AfD Landtag president.

lead.what: India's MPC raised the repo 25 basis points to 5.50% on 7 October, the first increase since February 2023. There is a 62% probability it leaves the repo at 5.50% at the December 2-4 meeting.

lead.what: Maryland and Baltimore County announced Anduril's $3.7 billion Arsenal-2 shipyard in Baltimore County. The state and county pledged to match up to 13% of the private investment.

rest.what: The Associated Press reported that Trump said the deal will allow U.S. taxpayers to take a 40% stake in the shipyard.
